name: io.github.moncef00327-cloud/quantum-aether
title: Quantum Aether
description: Post-quantum TLS evidence; x402 USDC on Base for full reports and sector snapshots

tools.name: scan_tls
tools.description: Run a new, rate-limited TLS scan of a public hostname on port 443. Returns observation_status, measured time, negotiated group and certificate summary. Starts an external connection and stores a publicly accessible result. Does not judge application safety.

domain.description: Public DNS hostname, for example example.com. HTTPS port 443 only.

tools.name: get_tls_evidence
tools.description: Read existing TLS evidence with source, checked_at, expires_at and fresh/stale/undetermined/not_scanned state. Never starts a new network scan. A missing record is not proof that a domain is unsafe.

domain.description: Public DNS hostname, for example example.com. HTTPS port 443 only.

tools.name: exposure_window
tools.description: Quantum Exposure Registry: from when a domain was first observed, the week it first negotiated post-quantum key exchange (first_pq_week), the observed classical exposure window (harvest-now-decrypt-later, a lower bound), regressions, the weekly timeline with row fingerprints and OpenTimestamps anchor proofs, and same-network peers. Read-only, never scans. External observation, not a compliance certification.

domain.description: Public DNS hostname, for example example.com. HTTPS port 443 only.

tools.name: get_methodology
tools.description: Get the documented measurement scope, observation states, certificate-grade rules and privacy limitations before interpreting a TLS result.

tools.name: get_example_result
tools.description: Return an explicitly labeled archived example, not live telemetry. No payment and no network scan.

tools.name: get_service_info
tools.description: Get live endpoints, quotas, report price, x402 Base USDC checkout status and limitations.

tools.name: get_full_report
tools.description: Paid x402 tool: $49.00 USDC on Base per report (x402 v2, exact scheme, one-time per scan). Fetch the full report for a completed scan. If unpaid, returns a standard x402 v2 PaymentRequired challenge for exact USDC on Base. Calling without a signed payment never charges. An x402-enabled MCP client may sign and retry under the buyer wallet’s own spend policy. Payment is settled before report access is returned.

scan_id.description: ID returned by scan_tls. A compatible x402 MCP client handles the Base USDC payment challenge.

tools.name: get_sector_snapshot
tools.description: Paid x402 tool: $0.50 USDC on Base per call (x402 v2, exact scheme). Read-only: every domain of one sector watch list (banks, government, cyber agencies, telecom, insurers ...) in the latest weekly registry measurement, with grade, key-exchange group, TLS version and post-quantum status, plus a summary. Without a signed payment it returns the x402 PaymentRequired challenge and never charges. Sectors: audit-advisory-legal, banks-americas-apac, banks-dach, banks-europe, banks-mena, cloud-security, companies-dach, critical-infrastructure, crypto-exchanges, cyber-agencies-worldwide, enterprise-saas-b2b, finance-worldwide, global-insurance-healthcare, government-dach, government-gcc, government-worldwide, health-insurance-dach, payments-fintech, pqc-security-vendors, quantum-research-universities, secure-communication, semiconductors-hardware, telecom.

tools.name: create_full_report_order
tools.description: Create a one-time full-report order for an existing scan. This does not transfer funds. Only set consent_immediate_delivery true after the payer has expressly agreed to immediate delivery and applicable withdrawal terms. The payer must send USDT on Polygon and then submit its transaction hash using verify_full_report_payment.

consent_immediate_delivery.description: Set true only after the payer explicitly agrees to immediate delivery and the applicable withdrawal-right terms.

tools.name: verify_full_report_payment
tools.description: Submit the payer-provided Polygon transaction hash. The server checks the confirmed USDT transfer, exact order amount and recipient on chain. Returns the private report URL only after confirmation.
